AGENDA SUMMARY PAGE
Agenda Item No.:
City Council
66
Meeting of: September 16, 2026
OFFICE: Office of Emergency Management DISCUSSION
MANAGER: Carolyn Levering
SUBJECT:
REPORTS AND PRESENTATIONS:
Report by Carolyn Levering, Manager, Office of Emergency Management (OEM), on the Office's
mission to coordinate and integrate all activities necessary to build, sustain, and improve the
city's capacity to mitigate against, prepare for, respond to, and recover from threatened or
actual natural disasters, acts of terrorism, or other man-made disasters affecting the city of Las
Vegas - All Wards
FISCAL IMPACT:
None
PURPOSE/BACKGROUND:
This report will highlight the mission of the Office of Emergency Management to coordinate and
integrate all activities necessary to build, sustain, and improve the city's capacity to mitigate
against, prepare for, respond to, and recover from threatened or actual natural disasters, acts of
terrorism, or other man-made disaster affecting the City of Las Vegas.
RECOMMENDATION:
Report only; no action required
BACKUP DOCUMENTATION:
1. Submitted at Meeting - PowerPoint Presentation by Staff
